open_points.subject: install_transport_guards
open_points.text: each check either produces the response named for it and ends the request there, or leaves the request untouched for the next check to evaluate. A check that does not produce a response MUST NOT call the next handler, MUST NOT return, and MUST NOT cause any later check to be skipped; the next handler is called exactly once, after every check in the list has left the request unrefused. The checks are: derive a request id carrying no identity or credential material; reject the request with 400 when _host_allowed refuses the request host against settings.trusted_hosts; answer an OPTIONS request carrying an Origin listed in settings.allowed_origins with a 204 preflight echoing the requested method and headers plus Vary Origin, together with the allow-origin and allow-credentials headers every allowed-origin response carries, and reject an unlisted origin with 403;
open_points.other_text: A POST to /auth/viewer/logout whose Origin is accepted therefore still passes through the body-size check, and so does every other request that is not refused before it.
open_points.question: Must an allowed OPTIONS preflight end immediately with its 204 response, or must it continue through the body-size check because it was not refused?
